scope_note: Real images for the detector smoke check (AC1) and the PyTorch/ONNX parity sample (AC3). Not a benchmark: no ground truth, no split, a handful of hand-picked photographs. Images are never committed; python -m aeris.detection.samples fetch downloads them to data/raw/detector_samples/ and writes the verified provenance there.
selection_note: Commons candidates were shortlisted on 2026-09-25 from web search results. They were fetched on 2026-09-26, after the owner allowed the Commons hosts. For each fetched file the Commons API reported an allowed licence, recorded under license_verified. Originals were checked against Commons' SHA-1; renditions are pinned by SHA-256 here. Three candidates were refused because Wikimedia rate-limited the original download (HTTP 429). The fetched photos form parity_sample.real in configs/detector/baseline.json.
allowed_licenses_note: Commons licence codes, matched as shell-style patterns: public domain, CC0, CC BY and CC BY-SA of any version. NC and ND variants are refused.
fetch_width_note: Commons serves its own scaled rendition when the original is wider than 2048 px. The detector letterboxes to 640 px, so 2048 px keeps the full input detail at a few MB per file.

entries.license_note: Shipped in the Apache-2.0 YOLOX repository at the pinned commit; the repository does not name the photographer or give separate terms. Used locally only, not redistributed.
